notes:
Lead origin: inbound via website contact form (self-serve interest).

Summary:
- SMB vendor building a lightweight customer-support automation plugin for Zendesk and Freshdesk.
- Primary ask: hosted API to prototype ticket summarization, structured output (JSON fields for ticket metadata), and tool calling to 'close ticket' via webhook.
- Wants minimal engineering lift: self-serve signup, short onboarding, clear SDK examples for node/python and a sample webhook.

Security/Compliance:
- Requires SOC2 report before moving to production. SSO (SAML) planned but out of scope for first POC.
- Concerned about audit logs and retention; asked whether Redwood stores prompt text beyond 30 days.

Technical snippets from call:
- "We need a reliable summarizer that produces 3-line summaries and structured fields like priority, intent, follow_up_flag." — Head of Product (Ari Patel)
- Latency target: p95 under ~500ms for single-ticket summarize calls; throughput low initially (~50-200 req/min) but bursts up to 500/min during campaign sends.
- Model preference: open model family preferred for cost control; willing to try Redwood curated variants.

POC plan discussed:
- 1) Self-serve signup to Hosted API, generate key.
- 2) Upload 2k-ticket anonymized export (shared via Drive link).
- 3) Run batch summarization + structured-output extraction via API.
- 4) Validate outputs against human-labeled subset.
- 5) If quality and latency acceptable, move to a 3-month paid sandbox (reserved credits).

Sales notes:
- Price sensitivity: SMB budget, looking for pay-as-you-go; estimated ARR if converted: $6k-20k/yr.
- No legal review yet. Customer asked for a one-page security FAQ and SOC2 link.

Action items:
- AE (Maya) to send onboarding guide and sample SDK snippets (by 2026-03-10).
- SE (Diego) to share recommended prompt templates for summarization + structured-output JSON schema and batching tips.
- Provide SOC2 report and clarify retention rules for Hosted API.

use_case_summary: Prototype hosted API integration for ticket summarization and structured extraction; add tool-calling webhook to allow agents to mark tickets resolved. Primary goal: reduce average handle time and improve SLA compliance for SMB customers.
technical_requirements: p95 latency <= 500ms for single-ticket summarize calls
structured JSON output with deterministic keys (priority, intent, follow_up_flag)
support for small batch jobs (up to 5k tickets) and burst throttling
demo_feedback: Early runs show ~82% match to human labels for priority/internet extraction on 200-sample test. Customer wants tuning to reduce false positives on follow_up_flag.
customer_quote: If we can plug this into our Zendesk workflow with minimal infra, we'll be able to roll to all customers in Q3.
notes_short: SMB inbound, wants self-serve Hosted API POC for ticket summarization and tool calling; SOC2 required for production.
